title: Australian Education Amendment (Save Our Public Schools) Bill 2023
short_title: Australian Education Amendment (Save Our Public Schools) Bill 2023

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require the federal government to raise its share of funding for government schools to at least 25 percent.
It would change the definition of the Commonwealth share in the Australian Education Act 2013 and add an object stating every school-aged child should have access to a fully funded government school.
The new obligation would apply from the day after the Act receives Royal Assent.
changes: Redefines the Commonwealth share for government schools to 25 percent or higher.
Inserts a new object into the Act about access to fully funded government schools.
Requires the federal education Minister to ensure funding determinations are consistent with that object.
summary.affected: The federal government, state and territory governments, and students at government schools.
